Ordinary fine-tuning is expressly conceded and therefore cannot by itself contradict the claim.

The supplied context names Muse Spark 1.2 but also describes a newly released open-weight model. Muse Glimmer is a candidate referent; that identification is not silently assumed.
The post-training clause is a factual concession, not an antecedent of a conditional forecast.

criteria.contradiction_condition: For the intended release, public artifacts or reproducible demonstrations establish that outsiders could perform the specified original-training modifications and investigations. Permission to make derivatives or ordinary fine-tuning alone is insufficient.
